The tip is E060: 5.178 s, 0.7533 on seeds 0–2. Same-commit rebuilds of E049 read 5.193–5.223 s, so time noise is about ±0.03 s. The 3-seed accuracy mean moves about ±0.2 pp across rebuilds. E049's builds read 0.7535, 0.7552 and 0.7536.

Mechanisms, with supporting experiments:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 0.8–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near that dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048). E059 vs E049 shows the 0.25-epoch difference sits at the edge of build time noise.
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share. A frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, optimizer traffic and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049). It is free only after the block's learning has finished (H7). Group 1 needs 32 px exposure (E037, E054, E055).
4. Activation cost is partly compute-bound. ReLU saved 0.25 s but lost 0.54 pp (E056). Smoothness matters.
5. Averaging variants, LS changes, warm-up, Lookahead interval and BN recalibration are null or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044). wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp. The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more than it saves.
7. Build noise and the seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The unselected population mean is about 0.752–0.754.
8. Time forecasts: the tip sits near 5.18 s. Trims below 1% are not visible in wall time.

Unsure: the true rebuild SD, whether coarse labels are usable (likely not, since TrainingData has only fine labels), PCIe transfer, and whether Muon beats SGD on CIFAR-100.

Expectations: I095 loses about 0.15–0.2 pp for about 0.07 s. I096 drops accuracy by about 0.3 pp or more, because E006 plausibly gained from Muon. I097 will probably close. I098 is roughly neutral to slightly negative.

forecasts.reason: Removing early steps trades near the dial; about -0.15 pp for about -0.07 s, which fails the gate.
Muon likely gives real gains at 9 epochs, and the NS saving is only about 0.15–0.2 s.
Tanh-GELU may save little; the likely outcome is that the offline gate closes it with no run, leaving the tip's numbers.
Early steps carry accuracy, so a small loss is likely, but the time saving is only about 0.03–0.08 s.

cruxes: What is the true rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean? It decides whether any sub-0.15 pp keep decision is real.
Does Muon beat Nesterov SGD on this CIFAR-100 recipe once batch size and RNG are controlled?
Does the PCIe judge's own build keep the unselected population mean at or above 0.7515?
